fusions.name: Streaking Surge
fusions.desc: Charges in a streak of raw arcana at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range, and ignoring its resistances.

fusions.name: Flaring Hoofstrike
fusions.desc: Stamps out a flare of raw arcana, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Worked to a Lather
fusions.desc: Restores 20 mana. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Charged Canter
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
